title: Equal Opportunity Cell | KPGU
content: more responsive to the needs and constraints of the disabled social groups. EOC shall ensure that students, staffs, faculties or the community from various diverse backgrounds, caste, creed, religion, language, ethnicity, gender and disability are not deprived of their righteous opportunities in terms of providing equity, free from any form of harassment, opportunities to higher educational institution, free from ragging, unfavorable treatment and victimization.
